profile.headline: Data & Software Engineer | Passionate About Data Science Applications
profile.summary:
Data and Software Engineer with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from North Seattle College, currently applying my skills across data engineering, software development, and data science. Most recently, I interned at Echodyne, where I developed a Python SDK and database APIs for radar science applications, implementing numerical optimization to synchronize radar and GPS measurements, quantify positional error, and evaluate target-data corrections for improved accuracy. Previously, I participated in an NSF-funded REU program at Washington State University, applying machine learning and data analysis to complex mass spectrometry data in the molecular biosciences domain.

Skilled in Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, machine learning, data processing, and software development, with additional experience in API development, workflow automation, and web design since December 2023. My experience spans applications in computational biology, radar science, and and business applications, including SEO, digital advertising, and business analytics to help clients improve their online presence and engagement.

I'm passionate about leveraging data science and computing to real-world challenges, whether through scientific research, engineering systems, or data-driven business solutions.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description: Selected to participate in an NSF-funded REU program focused on high-throughput data analysis in molecular biosciences. Processed and analyzed mass spectrometry data from wine samples impacted by wildfire smoke taint using computing cluster resources. Cleaned and prepared complex datasets, then applied supervised machine learning techniques—including Random Forest models with Boruta feature selection—to identify key chemical features associated with smoke taint.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Supervised Learning · Scientific Computing · Data Visualization · Python (Programming Language)

honors.title: Boeing Endowment Fund Scholarship Recipient
honors.description: Selected by Boeing as a recipient of this prestigious scholarship supporting prospective STEM students who demonstrate exceptional promise to make a meaningful impact in their fields. Recognized for academic excellence, leadership potential, and commitment to advancing technology and innovation.

honors.title: 3rd Place – Climate Solutions Poster Competition
honors.description:
Recognized for presenting a comprehensive climate solution at a community-wide competition hosted by 350Sandpoint.org and Sandpoint High School, focused on youth-led sustainability proposals.

My project explored the statewide adoption of hydrogen-fueled public transportation in Idaho, modeling the transition by analyzing bus fleet turnover, cost-benefit breakdowns, and long-term environmental impact. It demonstrated that replacing retiring diesel vehicles with hydrogen-powered alternatives could significantly reduce emissions while achieving cost savings through fuel efficiency and clean energy incentives.

Awarded 3rd place and a $200 scholarship among 50 competing entries.

projects.title: ShiftShift Motors
projects.description: Designed and developed a custom website for a JDM import car dealership using WordPress, delivering a fast, branded solution tailored to their niche. Created the visual identity from the ground up, including logo design and a cohesive automotive-inspired color palette. Integrated interactive plugins and lead capture features through dynamic forms to support customer inquiries and engagement. Managed the full site build, configuration, and launch, ensuring performance and usability on a quick turnaround.

projects.title: Duke & Duck
projects.description: Worked with an animation studio to migrate their WordPress website’s content delivery and lead tracking systems to a new provider. Responsible for configuring and styling all new lead capture forms, setting up gated content access, and integrating lead verification features to address bot submission issues. Used Figma-based designs to build branded email and newsletter templates within the new system, ensuring a seamless visual and functional transition.

organizations.name: Tech Talent Boost Washington
organizations.description: Participated in team-based development project focused on delivering real-world technical solutions for local businesses. Contributed as a full-stack developer, applying skills in JavaScript (Node.js/React), API integration, database design, and cloud deployment using AWS. Gained hands-on experience in agile development, code versioning, and product lifecycle management. Continuing as an active member in the program’s developer network.

organizations.name: American Chemical Society
organizations.description: Engaged in the ACS community to stay informed on cutting-edge research in chemical engineering, particularly where it intersects with machine learning and data science. Membership provides access to journals, newsletters, and technical competitions that inform and enhance my work in applying data-driven approaches to chemical problems.
